items.evidence: All six labware loaded with the specified labels and slots; p20 left and p300 right with correct tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
add(beads['A1'],40,mix=40) dispenses 40 µL to every well and mixes 10 times; the 5 min incubation is recorded by a comment before the magnet comment.

The magnet comment is recorded, then remove(90, waste) aspirates 90 µL at w.bottom(1) from all 96 wells with a fresh tip each; the 1 mm height is low but the beads are on a magnet, and the measured checks pass.
Two add(etoh,200) steps are each followed by remove(200,waste) across all wells; the end-state checks pass.

The dry and disengage comments are present and 50 µL of water is added, but the mix is 30 µL ×10 rather than a volume matching the 50 µL dispensed; the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage are comments only, which the task allows.
zip(wells, ewells) moves 45 µL from each sample well to the matching elution well, with column-order flattening applied to both plates so identity is preserved.
A fresh tip is picked up and dropped for every well in each step; the no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end checks pass. Using a new tip for every reagent addition is conservative.

Volumes are within p300 limits and the 1–2 mm bottom heights are reasonable, but reagent aspiration uses the default reservoir height, the beads are not pre-mixed, and there is no pause or operator prompt (only comments).
All steps are in the specified order with the specified volumes and comments, and there are no invented steps; the metadata is accurate.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the task's step order, uses the right labware and volumes, passes all measured checks, and uses a fresh tip for every well. Minor issues: the elution mix volume is 30 µL rather than a volume matching the 50 µL dispensed, and there are no operator pauses, only comments.
